description: Normative Bookclerk SQL v1 corpus. See docs/sql-contract/v1.md.

lowering.canonical: SELECT a FROM t WHERE id = ? AND name = ?
lowering.postgres: SELECT a FROM t WHERE id = $1 AND name = $2

lowering.canonical:
SELECT '?' AS literal, /* ? */ ? FROM t WHERE x = '?' -- ?
AND y = ?
SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.v') FROM t WHERE id = ?
lowering.postgres: SELECT (CASE WHEN (payload) IS JSON THEN ((payload)::jsonb #>> '{v}') END) FROM t WHERE id = $1

lowering.canonical: WHERE json_valid(payload) = 0 OR json_extract(payload, '$.v') IS NULL
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO t (id) SELECT ? RETURNING id
lowering.postgres: INSERT INTO t (id) SELECT * FROM (SELECT $1) AS _bc_src WHERE true  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id

lowering.canonical: insert or ignore into t (id) select ? returning id
lowering.postgres: INSERT INTO t (id) SELECT * FROM (select $1) AS _bc_src WHERE true  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT COALESCE(x, 0), CASE WHEN (attempt_count) IS NULL OR (1) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(attempt_count, 1) END
SELECT CASE WHEN (1) IS NULL OR (2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(1, 2) END, CASE WHEN (a) IS NULL OR (b) IS NULL OR (c) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(a, b, c) END

lowering.canonical: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a, b DESC
lowering.postgres: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a NULLS FIRST, b DESC NULLS LAST
